preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root of the AVL tree is either None or an instance of TreeNode.
The value to be inserted is an integer within the range of a 32-bit signed integer.

postconditions.expression: root is not None and isinstance(root, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The function returns a root node of the AVL tree.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and -2^31 <= x <= 2^31 - 1 for x in inorder_traversal(root))
postconditions.description: The inorder traversal of the tree after each insertion contains only integers within the range of a 32-bit signed integer.
The tree remains a valid AVL tree after each insertion.
